This site uses Entreluma to publish interactive stories with images, maps, video, and linked sources. Entreluma builds on the [Chirpy Jekyll theme](https://github.com/cotes2020/jekyll-theme-chirpy) and grew from the interactive storytelling work of [Juncture](https://labs.jstor.org/projects/juncture/).

To make this page your own, replace the text in `_tabs/about.md` with an introduction to your project and its contributors.
